categories.main_business_segments: US Foods operates as a single business segment focused on the marketing, sale, and distribution of fresh, frozen, and dry food and non-food products to foodservice customers across the United States. The company serves a wide range of customers, including independent and chain restaurants, healthcare, hospitality, education, government, and retail locations. US Foods manages its business with standardized processes, shared systems, and a centralized management structure, leveraging national scale with local execution.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: US Foods relies on a sophisticated logistics and distribution network, including over 70 distribution facilities, a fleet of more than 6,500 trucks, and approximately 90 cash-and-carry retail locations. The company utilizes advanced digital ordering platforms, business analytics tools, and category management systems to support sales and customer engagement. It also operates processing facilities for certain meat, poultry, seafood, and produce products, adhering to strict food safety and quality standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are independent restaurants, regional and national restaurant chains, healthcare institutions (such as hospitals and nursing homes), hospitality businesses (including hotels and entertainment venues), educational institutions, government entities, and retail outlets. US Foods targets independent restaurants, healthcare, and hospitality as its most profitable and strategically important customer segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: US Foods operates nationwide in the United States, with distribution and retail facilities in nearly every state. The company has a particularly strong presence in major metropolitan areas and continues to expand regionally through acquisitions, such as recent entries into upstate New York and California. All operations are conducted within the U.S., and the company does not have significant international business.
categories.supply_chain_position: US Foods is a downstream operator in the foodservice supply chain, acting as a broadline distributor that sources products from thousands of suppliers and delivers them to end customers in the foodservice industry. The company does not engage in primary production or manufacturing of most products but does operate some processing facilities for select categories.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is encapsulated in its 'GREAT FOOD. MADE EASY.' initiative, emphasizing differentiation through product assortment, customer experience, and innovation. US Foods invests in digital solutions, private brand development, sustainability (Serve Good® program), and value-added services to help customers operate more efficiently. Continuous improvement, operational efficiency, and selective acquisitions are also key strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: US Foods generates revenue primarily through the sale and distribution of food and non-food products to foodservice customers. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and acceptance of goods, with additional income from value-added services and private label products. The company also operates cash-and-carry retail outlets and offers digital ordering and direct ship services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: US Foods is one of the leading broadline foodservice distributors in the U.S., competing primarily with Sysco (the largest competitor), Performance Food Group, and numerous regional and local distributors. The company differentiates itself through its broad product assortment, value-added services, technology solutions, and national scale with local execution. The industry is highly competitive, with low switching costs and intense price and service competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal year 2023, US Foods reported net sales of $35.6 billion, gross profit of $6.1 billion, and net income of $506 million. The company experienced 4.5% year-over-year sales growth, driven by increases in case volume, especially among independent restaurant, healthcare, and hospitality customers. US Foods has a large national footprint, approximately 30,000 employees, and continues to grow both organically and through acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: US Foods emphasizes its ability to provide a comprehensive, innovative, and high-quality product assortment, supported by value-added services, digital tools, and expert consulting. The company’s private brands, sustainability initiatives, and omni-channel service model (including digital, direct ship, and cash-and-carry) offer customers flexibility, efficiency, and menu innovation. Its scale enables competitive pricing and reliable service, while local execution ensures tailored solutions for diverse customer needs.
